title: Memory Reactivation after Recurring Exposure
abstract: Immune memory reactivation selects high-affinity memory populations when a recognized threat signature recurs, enabling fast recall under a limited repertoire.

title: Niche Competition under Carrying Capacity
abstract: Ecological niche competition penalizes population overlap and supports specialization when resources and carrying capacity are limited.

title: Observability and State Estimation in Switching Systems
abstract: Observability-based state estimation updates latent state estimates from output innovations, but unobservable modes cannot be recovered.

title: Incentive Alignment for Reliable Allocation
abstract: Mechanism-design incentive alignment rewards truthful reports and allocates influence using reliability under a constrained budget.

title: Homeostatic Regulation under Perturbation
abstract: Homeostatic negative feedback responds to deviation from a viable range through bounded corrective feedback.
